name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: Amendment (3d) Article 12 is replaced by the following: "Article 12 Roles of the non-governmental actors 1. Non-governmental actors may play a role in the preparation and implementation of cooperation assistance, projects or programmes, and in the dissemination and exchange of information, as well as voicing citizen and civil society concerns on issues of mutual interest and programmes covered by the association, including in defining multi-annual indicative programmes, including by means of public consultations. They may receive a delegation of financial management powers for implementing such projects or programmes for the purpose of supporting local development initiatives. 2. Non-governmental actors eligible for decentralised management of projects or programmes shall be identified by agreement between the OCT authorities, the Commission and the Member State to which the OCT is linked, taking into account the subject concerned, their expertise and field of activity. The process of identification shall be conducted in each OCT as part of the broad dialogue and consultations referred to in Article 10. 3. The association aims to contribute to the efforts of the OCTs to strengthen civil society organisations, with particular emphasis on organisations representing indigenous peoples and local communities, in particular to facilitate their creation and development, and the development of the arrangements necessary for opening and enhancing their involvement in the design, implementation and evaluation of development strategies and programmes."
